parameters.help_en:
The audio or video ID. You can obtain the ID by using one of the following methods:
For videos uploaded through the console, log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose Media Files > Audio/Video to view the audio or video ID.
Obtain the video ID from the value of the VideoId response parameter when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55407.html operation to obtain the upload URL and credential.
After the video is uploaded, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html operation to query the audio or video ID, which is the value of the VideoId response parameter
parameters.help_zh:
音/视频ID。可通过以下方式获取：
通过控制台上传的视频，可登录点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择媒资库 > 音/视频查看音/视频ID。
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55407.html接口获取上传地址和凭证时，音/视频ID为返回参数VideoId的值。
视频上传后，可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html接口查询音/视频ID，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值
parameters.name: video_id

parameters.help_en:
The title of the audio or video file.

The title can be up to 128 bytes in length.
The value is encoded in UTF-8
parameters.help_zh:
音/视频标题。

长度不超过128个字节。

parameters.help_en:
The tags.

Each tag can be up to 32 bytes in length. A maximum of 16 tags can be specified.
Separate multiple tags with commas (,).
The value is encoded in UTF-8

标签。

单个标签不超过32字节。最多不超过16个标签。
多个标签之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。
UTF-8编码
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en:
The description of the audio or video file.

The description can be up to 1024 bytes in length.
The value is encoded in UTF-8
parameters.help_zh:
音/视频描述。

长度不超过1024个字节。
UTF-8编码

parameters.help_en:
The category ID. You can obtain the ID by using one of the following methods:
Log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose Configuration Management > Media Management > Categories to view the category ID.
Obtain the category ID from the value of the CateId response parameter when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/56401.html operation to create a category.
Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/56406.html operation to query the category ID, which is the value of the CateId response parameter
parameters.help_zh:
分类ID。可通过以下方式获取：
登录点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择配置管理 > 媒资管理配置 > 分类管理查看分类ID。
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/56401.html接口创建分类时，分类ID为返回参数CateId的值。
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/56406.html接口查询分类时，为请求后返回参数CateId的值
parameters.name: cate_id

parameters.help_en: The custom settings. The value is a JSON string that supports settings such as message callbacks and upload acceleration. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86952.html
parameters.help_zh: 自定义设置。为 JSON 字符串，支持消息回调、上传加速等设置。更多信息，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86952.html
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en: The custom ID. Only lowercase letters, uppercase letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores are supported. The value must be 6 to 64 characters in length and is unique at the user level
parameters.help_zh: 自定义 ID，仅支持小写字母、大写字母、数字、横线、下划线，长度 6-64 位。用户维度唯一
